event_model.request_identity: unique request_id bound across client and server raw records
event_model.durations: monotonic milliseconds for queue, inference, grounding, llm, serialization, server total, client total/transport
event_model.timestamps: RFC3339/ISO UTC with explicit timezone for resource samples
event_model.secret_policy: never record API keys, authorization headers, or raw environment values

workload.release_end_to_end_path: HTTP -> CampusAI retrieval/rerank -> grounding -> live uncached LLM -> citation validation -> response
workload.throughput: successful HTTP completions / measured monotonic wall duration; failed/queued/timeouts are not successful throughput

acceptance_boundary: Component pilot verifies real loopback transport and CUDA inference instrumentation only. Do not emit S6 PASS or M7 PASS until the full RAG/grounding/live-LLM endpoint run produces bound raw observations and matching capacity/HTTP reports.
